capture.zh: 击败酒醉的克莱芬后可再次挑战80级的清醒克莱芬，胜利获得成就「再次击败克莱芬」（精元已在第一战获得）。

strategy_notes.zh: 80级克莱芬速度很快，攻略作者用谱尼战胜。

engine_notes: Rematch reward is an achievement only; reward.monster is null.
HP not published; 5000 estimated from contemporary 80级 SPT bosses (古尔扎迪/米诺斯 ~5000).
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
source_note: 4399: 「这次是80级的克莱芬…速度貌似很不错…最后用谱尼战胜了」.
